findings: Device ID fallback weakens security — The _getDeviceId() method returns 'unknown_device' on error or unsupported platforms. validateOfflineToken explicitly skips device binding checks when stored device is 'unknown_device' (line 3847), meaning tokens created with this fallback aren't device-bound. Consider failing token creation instead of silently degrading, or at minimum log a warning when 'unknown_device' is used.
